help_modal.title: Help Center
help_modal.report_title: Report a Bug or Send Feedback
help_modal.report_desc: Did you find an issue or have a suggestion to improve the app? We appreciate your help! Click the button below to open your email client with a pre-formatted message. Please provide as much detail as possible.
help_modal.about_p1: My name is Daniel Cunha. My wife, Ayessa Cunha, and I are pastors and we live the challenges of ministry firsthand. CunhaLabs was born precisely from our own needs in church — and the sincere desire to transform difficulties into solutions that bless other people too.
help_modal.about_p2: What started as something simple for the two of us quickly showed a larger impact: tools that make work easier, organize the routine, and strengthen the ministry. This journey is driven by faith, dedication, and a passion for serving. And we keep moving forward, always seeking to deliver something better, clearer, and more useful for the body of Christ.
help_modal.version_news_li1: Official release of the MusicScale platform.
help_modal.version_news_li2: Integrated Live Library (Faster setlist and repertoire creation).
help_modal.version_news_li3: Performance Mode (Dynamic, high-contrast, responsive chords with live transposition).
help_modal.version_news_li4: Advanced Security and Integration with MillionsNest.
help_modal.faq_1_a: The Live Library is an integrated bank of standardized songs. Instead of adding songs manually, you can search our curated repository, which already contains lyrics, chords, and metrics (like BPM), saving a lot of time when building your repertoire.
help_modal.faq_2_q: How do I use Performance Mode (Chords Viewer)?
help_modal.faq_2_a: Inside a music schedule or directly in your repertoire, if the song has chords, the option to open the Viewer will appear. It adjusts contrast, formats chords above the lyrics, and allows live transposition, all with smooth animations and great contrast.
help_modal.faq_3_q: How do I create a music schedule for a service?
help_modal.faq_3_a: Go to 'Schedules' > 'Music'. Click 'New Schedule'. Fill in the event details (date, location) and pull songs from your team's repertoire. You can link YouTube/Spotify videos for practice and review the chords for the day.
help_modal.faq_4_q: How do I integrate the band with the music schedule?
help_modal.faq_4_a: First, create the Music Schedule. Then, create a 'Band Schedule' for the same event and assign your instrumentalists and vocalists. The system links both so everyone has access to the repertoire and chords of the day in a single click.
help_modal.faq_5_q: A member's access has expired or shows 'Inconsistency Detected'. What should I do?
help_modal.faq_5_a: The app is integrated with the MillionsNest platform. If the ministry's subscription expires, leaders or administrators need to renew it there. The app automatically updates when the subscription is re-activated, restoring access for the entire team.
help_modal.tutorial_1_content: We recommend starting by searching for songs in the 'Live Library'. When you add a song to your repertoire, it already comes with its original key, metrics, and links. From there, just build your setlist for the events, knowing that everyone is studying the same version.
help_modal.tutorial_2_content: For leaders, singers, and musicians, the app features Performance Mode. A dark screen designed specifically for stage use, with clean scrolling and real-time formatted chords. Need to change the key last minute? The transposition buttons on the screen adjust the pitch smoothly without reloading.
help_modal.tutorial_3_content: Administrators manage the team. Every member invited to your organization gets access as long as the ministry's subscription is active. The system defines each person's role (Admin, Leader, Musician), restricting schedule edits to authorized users only, keeping your data secure.
